svg.title: Lifting the follower arm
svg.desc: A right triangle. A fixed pivot sits at the right; an 80 mm arm starts flat along the horizontal base and lifts at its free left end, opening an angle theta at the pivot. The free end rises by the throw t, equal to L times tan theta. The angle sweeps up to about 17.6 degrees, where t is about 25.3 mm, then back down.
